create_repo_hf_model: create a new Hugging Face repository for a model with private visibility
upload_file_to_hub: upload a local file to a Hugging Face Hub repository with a commit message
list_models_filter: list Hugging Face models filtered by pipeline tag and sorted by downloads
download_model_weights: download a specific file from a Hugging Face model repository to local cache
create_discussion_pr: create a pull request discussion on a Hugging Face repository with a description
